claims: Gold prices have recently declined from record highs.
Investors are favoring the dollar over gold amidst geopolitical tension, say The Economic Times.
Robust oil prices have fueled inflation fears that diminish the appeal of non-yielding bullion, say The Economic Times.
The U.S. dollar has rebounded, causing an inverse effect on gold prices, as highlighted in this YouTube video.
Investors are adjusting expectations to believe the Federal Reserve will maintain higher interest rates for longer, note The Economic Times.
Investors have currently turned to the U.S. dollar as their primary safe-haven asset, say this YouTube video.
Rising energy and oil prices are driving concerns about persistent inflation.
Forbes and CNBC reported downward pressure on gold.
